en.headline: Mong Kok rooftop fire put out, no injuries reported
en.dek: The blaze at Shun King Building on Nelson Street was extinguished at about 6:42pm after 30 to 40 residents left the building.
body: The rooftop fire at Shun King Building, 2 to 2K Nelson Street in Mong Kok, was extinguished at about 6:42pm on Tuesday. Police had received multiple calls from about 5:28pm reporting the fire.
About 30 to 40 residents made their own way to the ground floor. No injuries were reported. The fire was suspected to have started among items stored on the rooftop, which was not occupied.

Firefighters used one hose and a breathing-apparatus team, and also directed water from a neighbouring rooftop. Police later arranged for residents to register at the junction of Tong Mi Road and Argyle Street. A security guard told reporters he had knocked on doors to tell occupants to leave, and had asked people with mobility difficulties to stay indoors.

zh.headline: 旺角順景大廈天台火警救熄 暫無傷亡報告
zh.dek: 奶路臣街順景大廈天台火警於傍晚約6時42分救熄，約30至40名住戶自行走到地面，警方稱暫無人受傷。
body: 旺角奶路臣街2至2K號順景大廈天台火警，星期二傍晚約6時42分救熄。警方由下午約5時28分起接獲多宗報案。
約30至40名住戶自行疏散至地面，暫無受傷報告。初步消息指起火點為天台雜物，天台並無人居住。
消防以一條喉及煙帽隊灌救，並從毗鄰大廈天台射水。警方其後安排住戶到塘尾道與亞皆老街交界登記。大廈一名保安向記者表示，他曾逐戶拍門通知住戶離開，並着行動不便的住戶留在家中暫避。
